WITH behavior_to_trader AS (
  SELECT ab.translink as transreg, t.tradekind
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
),
distinct_trans_per_type AS (
  SELECT tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT transreg) as trans_count
  FROM behavior_to_trader
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(trans_count) as total_count, COUNT(*) as num_types
  FROM distinct_trans_per_type
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT
    dt.tradekind,
    dt.trans_count,
    CAST(dt.trans_count as FLOAT) / t.total_count as share,
    1.0 / t.num_types as avg_share,
    t.total_count
  FROM distinct_trans_per_type dt
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  trans_count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as excess_over_avg
FROM with_shares
WHERE total_count IS NOT NULL AND share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC
